notes.title: Ability Update
notes.notes:
[b]Ability Update[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/26db399b71e59eb6edd197c10b1ba68a0a7644a3.png[/img]

- Players can now use abilities called "Bass" and "Treble" in all core game modes in Jinko. 

- Left click to use the "Bass" ability to slow down Jinko balls to 50% gravity for 3 seconds with a 15 second cooldown.

- Right click to use the "Treble" ultimate to freeze Jinko balls in place instantly for 1 second with a 20 second cooldown.

- Added cooldown bars to the UI to see when your ability and ultimate are ready to be used. 

- Added options to custom mode to toggle off and on abilities, which saves with your custom code 
also. 

[b]Other Updates[/b]

- Added RGB Jinker ball that changes color with a matching trail.

- Added Discord contest winning Jinker balls, "Ladybug" and "Fishbowl".
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/624b72f7fbd2a1e76a70c49a19f63065a3116ede.png[/img][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/dd0d0b4ef7d08457e35b22213385d02eeee69201.png[/img]

- Added display preview box for the Jinker ball. 

- Changed gameplay wall colors from light pink and blue to a darker color to put focus on gameplay area and reduce flashbang effect.

- Changed blue theme to be slightly darker saturation level to match pink theme. This was dont to reduce brightness of blue theme flashbang effect.

- Changed menu UI discord and wesbsite icons to have outline to be more visible. 

- Changed Jinko ball arrow indicators to order based on height with multiple layers instead of 2. Arrows will now appear in front based on priority of height of the Jinko ball. 

- Removed options button from UI in gameplay scenes. Just press the escape button LOL 

- Jinker ball now always follows the mouse. Removed left and right click inputs to move Jinker ball, as well as always follow toggle option removed.

- Updated settings controls options for new controls with abilities.

- Fixed Discord contest winner display box to have individual buttons for the background and small circles to click on to toggle between winners. 

- Fixed order layer of blue theme walls so that particle trails of Jinker balls would not some times appear behind it as they were on the same layer. 

- Fixed bug in leaderboard where players can click next page when at the max pages of 999. 

- Updated freeplay button UI for toggle floor and adding or removing Jinko balls.

notes.title: AUGUST 23 MAJOR CONTENT UPDATE
notes.notes:
- Added custom mode for players to create their own challenges and levels, by modifying the lives, gravity, time, and spawn rate. 

- Added an in-game achievements page to display the player's locked and unlocked Steam achievements.

- Added new button in the freeplay mode to disable and enable the floor. If the floor is disabled, Jinko balls will get destroyed falling out of the gameplay area. 

- Added Discord contest winner balls to game along with news display box to showcase winning submissions.

- Changed the freeplay mode floor height to match bottom of the screen, increasing space to fidget around and practice.

- Changed the freeplay mode add and remove button's graphics and locations.

- Changed the freeplay mode max Jinko ball count from 300 to 400.

- Changed horizontal distance between walls in all modes from 79% to 71%. This reduction will make overall gameplay less horizontally oriented, making the game slightly easier.

- Changed gameplay pause button in all modes to be fully opaque, and is no longer transparent. 

- Added 10 minute name change cooldown on leaderboard to prevent spam. Make sure to pick your name wisely!

- Changed ball arrow indicator sorting layer range from gameplay area increase from 15 to 25.

- Changed home button in gameplay settings menu, to leave button. This will bring you back to the previous menu.

notes.title: Jinko August 14th Update
notes.notes:
- Replaced lives ball graphic with heart graphic in the level selection menu.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/36e3692c0687b580ddd24cd7e303985407e12104.png[/img]

- Replaced lives ball graphic with heart graphic in the levels and arcade mode.

- Changed ball arrow indicators to now switch to a higher sorting later when close to the play area. 

- Added 1/8th and 1/16th Notes added under the BPM section in the level descriptions.

- Added level info boxes added to game over pop up in level mode.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/a7fa0202af0d608d6936cbb9f2018e115024e1e0.png[/img]

- Added restart attempt button to settings menu in the levels mode. 

- Added reset attempt text and keybind in the levels and arcade mode settings.

- Added spawn balls text and keybind in the freeplay mode settings.

- Changed leaderboard page number graphic to wide graphic box.

- Changed leaderboard default displayed positions number to 20 from 100 entries.

- Fixed bug where gameplay UI would stay on after losing if settings were open.

- Fixed bug on leaderboard when too many characters are typed into page number and position boxes.

notes.title: Jinko Update
notes.notes:
- New "black" and "white" player ball cosmetics have been added, free for all players to use!

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/b4c0909bc90d5d75afa07539b946e92ae5191f5d.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/62de13a24518783b8a19efe33b16f6e866ff6e1e.png[/img][/url] [url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/7071d26af4c5fa66209e63f300adc7e7976e9ad3.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/e4c1b5e7b569e66aed8c4a7b0e0a085cb6c83d76.png[/img][/url]

- Added escape keybind to open settings menu back into the levels and arcade mode.

- Opening the settings menu no longer pauses the game in the arcade mode.

- Added additional anti-cheat security measures.

notes.title: Jinko August 11th Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45121993/6dff4c626cf473fbedfa82327e5ed68bc57e9ffe.png[/img]

- New "Always Follow" toggle setting to disable left and right click controls completely. So say goodbye to accidentally clicking and messing up!

- Instant reset keybinds for Levels and Arcade mode. Lost an early life? Press R or Space to reset your current run!

- Graphics reworked to improve overall clarity and sharpness of images for all resolution sizes.

- The dot on the "i" in the Jinko menu logo now has collider physics the same as the "O".

- Escape button to pause removed from Levels and Arcade mode. Players must now click on the pause directly button to pause mid game, this should make the pause exploit completely useless as it requires a direct keybind

- Additional security measures for cheating
